topic: Cover-one-eye check: one eye can be weak without you noticing

youtube.title: Cover one eye. Is it still clear? 👁️ Try now #Shorts
youtube.description:
Quick test: cover one eye right now. Is everything just as clear?
ஒரு கண்ணை மூடிப் பாருங்கள்: இரண்டு கண்களும் ஒரே போல் தெரிகிறதா?

• Your brain blends both eyes, so the stronger eye hides a weaker one.
• Check each eye on a far clock or sign board, once a month.
• In children, a lazy eye is easiest to treat when found early: every child needs an eye test.
• In adults, one blurry eye can be uncorrected power, cataract or a retina problem.
• Note blur, wavy lines or dark spots in either eye.
• Sudden blur or a dark patch in one eye: see an eye specialist the same day.

gmb.text: Try this simple check: cover one eye and look at a far clock or sign board, then switch eyes. Your brain blends both eyes into one picture, so a stronger eye can hide a weaker one for a long time. In children, a lazy eye is easiest to treat when it is found early, which is why every child needs an eye test. In adults, one blurry eye may be due to uncorrected power, cataract or a retina problem, and only an eye test can tell. Do this check once a month and note any blur, wavy lines or dark spots. If one eye suddenly turns blurry or shows a dark patch, see an eye specialist the same day. Home eye test in Chennai: ₹100 for the whole family. Book an eye test on WhatsApp: 044 4356 9998
